title: Getting Started with JavaScript
content: JavaScript is one of the most popular programming languages in the world. It powers interactive web applications and is used both on the client side and the server side. Learning JavaScript opens the door to frameworks such as React, Vue, and Node.js.
author: Emma Wilson

title: Understanding REST APIs
content: REST APIs allow applications to communicate with each other over HTTP. They provide endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting resources. Understanding API design is essential for modern web developers.
author: Lucas Martin

title: The Future of Web Development
content: Web development continues to evolve rapidly with advances in AI, edge computing, and modern frameworks. Developers must stay informed about emerging technologies to build scalable and maintainable applications.
author: Sophia Turner

title: Why TypeScript Matters
content: TypeScript extends JavaScript by adding static typing. This helps developers catch errors earlier in the development process, improve code readability, and maintain larger codebases more effectively.
author: David Brown

title: Building Responsive Websites
content: Responsive design ensures that websites look and function correctly on desktops, tablets, and smartphones. Techniques such as CSS Grid, Flexbox, and media queries are key tools for achieving responsiveness.
author: Olivia Garcia

title: Introduction to PHP Frameworks
content: PHP frameworks like Laravel and Symfony provide developers with tools to build secure and scalable applications. They offer routing, authentication, database abstraction, and many other features out of the box.
author: Thomas Bernard

title: Deploying Applications to the Cloud
content: Cloud platforms make it easier than ever to deploy and scale applications. Services such as managed databases, container orchestration, and serverless functions help teams focus on delivering value instead of managing infrastructure.
author: Sarah Johnson
